svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="9GONlBjGwFrC8bON-Ifi"> <mxGraphModel dx="1047" dy="1023" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data":"@startuml
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0

enum TransactionMode {
 SELL
 TRADE
 LEND
}

enum SchoolLevel {
 BASIC_1_9
 SECONDARY_10_12
 HIGHER_EDUCATION
}

enum ListingStatus {
 AVAILABLE
 PENDING
 SOLD
}

class User {
 +String id
 +String name
 +String email
 +Float rating
 +register()
 +joinOrganisation(inviteCode)
}

class Organisation {
 +String id
 +String name
 +String inviteCode
 +addUser(user)
}

abstract class Listing {
 +String id
 +String title
 +String description
 +List<Photo> photos
 +Integer conditionRating
 +TransactionMode mode
 +SchoolLevel level
 +ListingStatus status
 +String subject
}

class SingleItem extends Listing {
 +Float price
}

class Pack extends Listing {
 +List<SingleItem> items
 +Float bundledPrice
}

class Transaction {
 +String id
 +DateTime timestamp
 +Float amount
 +Boolean isEscrowReleased
 +confirmDelivery()
}

class Payment {
 +String transactionId
 +String method (Card, MBWay, MB)
 +String status
}


class ChatMessage {
 +String id
 +String content
 +DateTime sentAt
}

class Review {
 +Integer stars
 +String comment
}

class Wishlist {
 +List<String> criteria
 +addAlert()
}

' Relationships
User \"1\" -- \"*\" Listing
User \"1\" -- \"*\" Organisation
User \"1\" -- \"0..1\" Wishlist 

Listing \"1\" -- \"0..1\" Transaction 
Transaction \"1\" -- \"1\" Payment 

Transaction \"1\" -- \"2\" Review 
User \"2\" -- \"*\" ChatMessage 
ChatMessage \"*\" -- \"1\" Listing 

@enduml","format":"svg"}" id="RO3FBYB5Wwu3fGKRE8a9-1"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="898" width="856" x="20" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
